purpose: M3 accuracy table of docs/INTENT_V0_WORK_ORDER.md: pixel and feet error and abstention rate of the assistant catcher-setup reading against one person's hand labels, on games the method was not built on
status_at_writing: the evaluation games were chosen from the schedule and content listings only (game ids, broadcasters, condensed-game titles and durations); no frame of them had been viewed or read

development_games.built_on_it: M1 reading protocol, hop 1 v1 front-edge similarity, hop 2 tilt from the batter's box, the human-verified catch subset
the condensed-game scan and read prompts, the two-reader consensus rule (15 px), the hop-2 pan term from the pitching rubber

evaluation_games.rule: E1: among the 2026 Wild Card Game 1s other than 849843 (849845, 849849, 849851), the lowest gamePk whose statsapi content lists a Condensed Game with an mp4Avc playback. E2 (a broadcaster other than SNY and NBC): among the regular-season games of the final weekend (2026-09-26/27), the latest one whose statsapi schedule lists a national TV broadcaster, with a Condensed Game mp4Avc playback.

games.label: E1
games.matchup: Philadelphia Phillies at Atlanta Braves (NL Wild Card Game 1)

games.label: E2
games.matchup: Tampa Bay Rays at Philadelphia Phillies

evaluation_games.fallback: if E1 and E2 together give fewer than 50 person-marked pitches, add 849849 and then 849851 (the next Wild Card Game 1s by gamePk) under the same frozen method; record the addition in the evaluation notes

frozen_method.code: intent/ as of the commit that adds this file. Any change to intent/ before both evaluation games are read and their outputs committed is a deviation and is listed in docs/INTENT_V0_M3_EVAL.md.
steps: Workflow intent/workflows/condensed_scan.js (two readers per ~80 s range of 2-fps contact sheets)
python -m intent.condensed map (pair readers <= 1.5 s; match by half, inning, batter, count; ties broken by the post-pitch type/speed graphic, then the outcome)
python -m intent.broadcast_windows (release +/- 1.5 s, every 3rd source frame, 2x gridded crops)
python -m intent.condensed read-args, then Workflow intent/workflows/condensed_read.js (two readers per three pitches)
python -m intent.condensed assemble (mean of the two readers on the same frame, reader A otherwise; abstain when mitt points are > 15 px apart or only one reader found a setup frame)
python -m intent.calibrate (tilt from the batter's-box lines, pan from the pitching rubber, catch-vs-Statcast check)
python -m intent.run, checked with the service validator validate_intent_estimate
operator_choices_allowed: the reading crop box and the labeling-pack crop boxes: one fixed box per game, chosen from the plate position on one centre-field frame before any reading, without marking a mitt

scan decisions the map step leaves open (unresolved ties, graphic conflicts, detections without a score bug): assign or drop with a written reason, using the score bug, the post-pitch graphic, the pitch order and the visible outcome, never the Statcast pitch location or the mitt
re-running a reader agent that ended with a tool or API error, with the identical prompt
not_allowed: changing the reader prompts, the consensus rule, the calibration or the hop formulas after seeing any evaluation frame
looking at the person's labels before the assistant outputs (points, calibration, JSONL) of that game are committed

human_labels.pack: python -m intent.label_pack with a sample larger than the game's pitch count, so every output line of the game is in the pack (no sampling)
human_labels.blind: the page shows no assistant point, no assistant status and no pitch result
human_labels.frame: the person labels the assistant's decision frame (the setup frame, or for an abstention the frame the assistant cited); which frame is the right setup frame is not evaluated
human_labels.labeler: the repository owner, one pass, time recorded by the page
human_labels.order: the assistant outputs of a game are committed before its pack is handed to the person

per_game: pitches in the output and their share of the game's feed pitches
person abstention rate and the availability table (both marked, both abstained, assistant only, person only)
mitt pixel distance, assistant vs person, median and 90th percentile (both marked)
output feet error: published plate_feet minus the person's mitt through the person's plate edge and the game's hop-2 matrix; distance, |x| and |z|, median and 90th percentile
camera check: catch-vs-Statcast rms (assistant readers), as already defined in intent.calibrate
metrics.pooled: the same error summaries over the evaluation games only; development games are never pooled with them
metrics.threshold: none set in advance; the report states the numbers with n
metrics.tool: python -m intent.human_labels per game, then python -m intent.accuracy_report -> docs/results/mlb_p0/intent_accuracy_report_v0.json
